d:
The Trail Blazers defeated the Spurs, 116-111 tonight in Portland. Deni Avdija finished with a team-high 33 points along with 12 rebounds and 7 assists for the Trail Blazers, while Damian Lillard tallied 29 points, 7 assists and 5 three pointers in the game. Victor Wembanyama recorded 44 points, 16 rebounds and 3 assists. The Trail Blazers improve their record to 12-6 with the win, while the Spurs fall to 15-4 for the season.
